==Active Ability: Soul Restraint: Level 0==
[[File:SoulRestraint0Icon.png|thumb|left]]When the moon turns red and the area is encased in a bloody fog, {{PAGENAME}} lets go of all restraints and summons a total of 20 units from the base, composed of 15 Ghouls and 5 Ghoul Riders, with the Ghoul Riders having 2 bars, letting them collide with enemies twice.

Note that the Ghoul Riders would clip through enemies when they hit them with the first bar.

* Global Cooldown: 120s
